_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); automaker signals, the early era

pit_profile.why: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Industry sales volume in any of our key markets can be volatile and could decline if there is a financial crisis, recession, or significant geopolitical event.' and 'Ford’s results are dependent on sales of larger, more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2019 10-K); EV (live from about 2020) is not on the watch list: no risk factor of this 10-K names a shift away from Ford's combustion-engine vehicles, so its words on larger, more profitable vehicles stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Industry sales volume in any of our key markets can be volatile and could decline if there is a financial crisis, recession, or significant geopolitical event.' and 'Ford’s results are dependent on sales of larger, more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2019 10-K); EV (live from about 2020) is not on the watch list: no risk factor of this 10-K names a shift away from Ford's combustion-engine vehicles, so its words on larger, more profitable vehicles stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.27x; -5% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.97; conservative 2yr +22%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -28.0%/yr (worst year FY10-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-14.4%/yr (Q1 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +-5.1%/yr (FY10-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +14.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: F (retrospective, 2020-07-17) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.27x (41.2% downside to Bear $4 / +32.4% upside to Bull $9) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 2.62: gap -0.97 [OVERVALUED] | -5% above the EPP floor $7 (6x FY20E $1.19) | Conservative 2-yr case: +22.5% total (+11.3%/yr) | At 5.7x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $9 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; wholesale units -21.0% in Q1 2020, forward revenues -14.9% (no Q2 2020 revenue guide, Q1 2020 revenue as reported); EV is live but no 10-K risk factor names a shift away from Ford's combustion-engine vehicles yet.
